d635894db531bf11df2ebbfd4101b5b37700e519.definition: The value printed on a note or a coin, such as 20 or 500.
d635894db531bf11df2ebbfd4101b5b37700e519.gloss: The value printed on a note or a coin, such as 20 or 500.

d635894db531bf11df2ebbfd4101b5b37700e519.text: The shop keeps one drawer for the smallest denomination and one for the notes.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: The behaviour a person uses to get a partner's attention back when they feel the bond is slipping.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: The behaviour a person uses to get a partner's attention back when they feel the bond is slipping.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: The behaviour a person uses to get a partner's attention back when they feel the bond is slipping.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: 関係が危ういと感じた時、相手から注意を引き戻す行動。

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: 상대의 관심이나 반응이 줄어든다고 느낄 때 이를 되돌리기 위해 반복 연락하거나 거리두는 등 보이는 행동이다. 갈등을 표현하려는 의도가 있으나 상대에게 부담을 줄 수 있다.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: 관계가 흔들린다고 느낄 때 상대의 관심과 반응을 되돌리기 위해 보이는 행동.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: Substantivo que designa as condutas com as quais a pessoa chama de volta a atenção do parceiro quando sente o vínculo slipping, como insistir em mensagens ou cobrar respostas. Cuidado: não se confunda com briga aberta.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: O comportamento usado para recuperar a atenção do parceiro quando o vínculo parece estar se desfezendo.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: Kata ini menunjuk tindakan seperti mengirim pesan berulang, menahan diri, atau cara lain untuk memancing respons, yang tujuannya memanggil pasangan kembali. Hati-hati: bukan berarti protes keras atau perkelahian.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: Perilaku yang dipakai seseorang untuk mendapatkan kembali perhatian pasangan saat merasa ikatannya mulai longgar.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: พฤติกรรมที่บุคคลแสดงออกเพื่อดึงความสนใจของคู่รักกลับมา เมื่อรู้สึกว่าความผูกพันกำลังอ่อนลง
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: พฤติกรรมที่ใช้เรียกร้องให้คู่รักกลับมาให้ความสนใจ

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.definition: Kişinin ilişkinin zayıfladığını hissettiğinde eşinin ilgisini yeniden kazanmak için sergilediği davranıştır. Mesajları tekrarlama, daha fazla ilgi gösterme ya da öfkeyle tepki verme biçimlerinde olabilir.
d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.gloss: Bağın gevşediğini hissederek eşinin ilgisini yeniden kazanma girişiminde sergilenen davranış.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.translation: Protest davranışı, mesajı iki kez, sonra üç kez göndermekti.
พฤติกรรมต่อต้านของเธอคือการส่งข้อความเดิมสองครั้งแล้วเพิ่มเป็นสามครั้ง
Protest behaviour-nya adalah mengirim pesan dua kali dan lalu tiga kali.
O comportamento de protesto dela era mandar a mensagem duas e depois três vezes.
그녀의 항의 행동은 같은 메시지를 두 번, 세 번 보내는 것으로 나타났다.
Her protest behaviour was sending the message twice and then three times.

d641c803734e2856e2168a7f238fcd0109ef2ad7.text: Her protest behaviour was sending the message twice and then three times.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: Describing a person who has no romantic partner, without saying whether that is a choice.
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: Describing a person who has no romantic partner, without saying whether that is a choice.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: 恋愛関係を持たない人を表す。その状態を選んでいるかどうかは含めない。
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: 交際相手のいない人の。

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: 현재 연인이나 배우자가 없는 사람을 뜻하는 표현이다. 그 상태가 본인의 선택인지 우연 때문인지는 나타내지 않는다.
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: 연인이 없는 사람을 뜻하되 혼자인 상태를 스스로 선택했는지는 말하지 않는다.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: Adjetivo usado para indicar que alguém não tem parceiro amoroso, sem especificar se essa condição foi escolhida.
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: Que descreve uma pessoa que não tem parceiro amoroso.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: Istilah ini hanya menyatakan bahwa seseorang tidak sedang memiliki pasangan asmara. Istilah ini tidak memberi informasi apakah keadaan tersebut dipilih atau BUMWE dll.
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: Orang yang tidak memiliki pasangan asmara, tanpa menyatakan apakah hal itu merupakan pilihan.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: เป็นลักษณะของบุคคลที่ไม่มีคู่รัก โดยไม่บ่งบอกว่าสถานะดังกล่าวเกิดจากการเลือกหรือไม่ได้เลือก
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: ไม่มีคู่รัก

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.definition: Romantik bir ilişkisi bulunmayan kişiyi anlatan ifade. Kişinin bu durumu kendi isteğiyle mi yaşadığı, yoksa başka bir nedenle mi olduğu konusunda bilgi vermez.
d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.gloss: Romantik ilişkisi olmayan kişiyi belirtir; durumun seçim mi olduğunu söylemez.

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.translation: Romantik bir ilişkisi olmadığını, bunu özür dilemeden söyledi.
เขาบอกว่าตัวเองไม่มีคู่รัก และพูดโดยไม่มีคำขอโทษในน้ำเสียง
Ia mengatakan bahwa ia tidak berpasangan dan mengatakannya tanpa meminta maaf.
Ele disse que estava sem parceiro e não pediu desculpas por isso.
그는 연인이 없다고 말했고, 그 말에는 어떤 사과도 섞여 있지 않았다.
彼は交際相手がいないと言ったが、声音には謝罪の気持ちはなかった。

d64c59a159acde302fe95bd2a05ed27171cfcf91.text: He said he was unpartnered, and he said it without any apology in his voice.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: The interest rate minus the inflation rate. It is the return a saver actually keeps in purchasing power.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: The interest rate minus the inflation rate. It is the return a saver actually keeps in purchasing power.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: 金利から通货膨胀率を控除した率で、預けた資金が実際の購買力をどれだけ維持できるかを表す。通货膨胀が金利を上回るとマイナスになる。
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: 名目金利から物価上昇率を差し引いた率。

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: 예금자가 실제로 유지하는 구매력을 기준으로 계산한 금리이다. 명목 금리가 물가 상승률보다 낮으면 실질 금리는 마이너스가 된다.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: 명목 금리에서 물가 상승률을 뺀 금리.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: Diferença entre a taxa de juros nominal e a taxa de inflação, que representa o rendimento realmente preservado em poder de compra.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: Taxa de juros descontada da inflação.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: Suku bunga yang dikurangi tingkat inflasi dan menunjukkan bagian imbalan yang benar-benar diperoleh dalam daya beli. Jika hasilnya negatif, daya beli simpanan justru berkurang.
อัตราดอกเบี้ยที่หักอัตราเงินเฟ้อออก แสดงถึงผลตอบแทนที่ผู้ออมเก็บเงินได้จริงในแง่กำลังซื้อ
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: อัตราดอกเบี้ยที่หักผลกระทบจากเงินเฟ้อแล้ว

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.definition: Mevduat sahibinin parasının satın alma gücü bakımından elinde tuttuğu getiriyi gösteren oran. Enflasyon faiz oranından yüksekse reel faiz eksi değere düşer.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.gloss: Nominal faiz oranından enflasyon oranı çıkarılarak bululan reel faiz oranı.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: Yüzde 4 getirili bir mevduat ve yüzde 6 enflasyon reel faiz oranını eksi yüzde 2 yapar.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: เงินฝากดอกเบี้ยร้อยละ 4 เมื่อเงินเฟ้อร้อยละ 6 จึงให้อัตราดอกเบี้ยจริงร้อยละลบ 2

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: Simpanan berbunga empat persen dengan inflasi enam persen menghasilkan suku bunga riil minus dua persen.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: Um depósito de 4% com inflação de 6% produz uma taxa real de juros de menos 2%.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: 연 4% 금리에 물가 상승률이 6%라면 실질 금리는 연 2% 마이너스이다.

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.
d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.translation: 金利が四％で通货膨胀率が六％なら、実質金利はマイナス二％だ。

d64e05ba4fa82f87fe75c7091126ba0da6aa44c9.text: A 4 % deposit with 6 % inflation gives a real interest rate of minus 2 %.

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: A statement that an argument starts from and takes as given.
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: A statement that an argument starts from and takes as given.

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: 議論の出発点となる、根拠として受け入れられる主張。与えられた前提が誤っていれば、そこから導かれた結論も誤りになり得る。
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: 議論の出発点として、与えられたままにされる主張。

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: 논증이 출발점으로 삼아 참이라고 가정하는 명제이다. 결론이 참이 되려면 그 전제도 검토해야 한다.
Afirmação que serve de ponto de partida e é aceita como dada em um argumento.
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: Afirmação que serve de ponto de partida e é aceita como dada em um argumento.

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: Pernyataan yang menjadi awal dan dasar sebuah argumen serta diterima sementara sebagai-given. Kata ini merujuk pada dasar penalaran, bukan pada kesimpulan.
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: Pernyataan yang menjadi awal dan dasar sebuah argumen.

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: ข้อความที่เป็นจุดเริ่มต้นและถือเป็นข้อกำหนดของการให้เหตุผล หากข้อกำหนดนี้ไม่ถูกต้อง ข้อสรุปที่อ้างอิงมันก็อาจไม่จริง
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: ข้อความที่เป็นจุดเริ่มต้นและถือเป็นข้อกำหนดของการให้เหตุผล

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.definition: Bir akıl yürütmenin başlayıp doğru kabul ettiği önerme. Kanıtlanan şey değildir; sonucun dayandığı temel varsayımdır.
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.gloss: Bir akıl yürütmenin başlayıp doğru kabul ettiği önerme.

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.translation: Önerme yanlıştır, bu yüzden sonuç yalnızca ispatta doğrudur.
ข้อกำหนดนี้ผิด ดังนั้นข้อสรุปจึงถูกต้องเฉพาะในการพิสูจน์
Premis itu salah, sehingga kesimpulannya hanya benar dalam pembuktian.
A premissa está errada, portanto a conclusão só está correta na prova.
출발 명제가 틀렸으므로 결론은 증명 안에서만 옳다.
前提が間違っているため、証明の中の結論が正しいのは偶然による。

d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.text: The premise is wrong, so the conclusion is right only in the proof.
d68e3ec2d5ff0cb321539a21d477615abc7bf2bc.translation: Tiền đề sai, nên kết luận chỉ đúng trong phạm vi của chứng minh.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: The move that puts the two sides in the wrong places, crediting the harm to the person who suffered it.
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: The move that puts the two sides in the wrong places, crediting the harm to the person who suffered it.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: 加害者だった人物を被害者に見立て、被害を受けた人物に害boxing Plains加えたりの役割を帰すことを指す。責任の所在を逆転させる手法である。
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: 加害者と被害者の立場を入れ替える操作。

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: 원래 가해자가 저지은 행위를 피해자의 잘못인 것처럼 뒤집어, 피해자를 가해자처럼 보이게 만드는 수법이다.
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: 가해자와 피해자의 역할을 뒤바꾸어, 발생한 피해를 피해자에게 돌리는 수법이다.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: Manobra que inverte as posições de vítima e agressor, fazendo com que o dano seja atribuído à pessoa que o sofreu.
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: Troca de papéis que atribui o dano a quem sofreu a ofensa.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: Gerakan yang menukar tempat kedua pihak, sehingga kesalahan dianggap sebagai kesalahan orang yang mengalaminya. Dengan begitu pihak yang merugikan terlihat sebagai pihak yang dirugikan.
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: Gerakan yang menukar tempat kedua pihak, sehingga kesalahan dianggap sebagai kesalahan orang yang mengalaminya.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: การจัดวางให้ผู้ที่ได้รับความเสียหายดูเหมือนเป็นผู้ก่อความเสียหาย และย้ายความผิดให้ไปตกอยู่กับผู้ที่เสียหาย
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: การสลับตำแหน่งผู้เสียหายกับผู้ก่อความเสียหาย

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.definition: Fail ile mağdurun rollerini tersine çeviren girişim. Bu girişimde zarar veren kişi zarardan kurtulurken, zararı yaşayan kişi suçluymuş gibi gösterilir.
d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.gloss: İki tarafın yerlerini değiştirerek zararı onu yaşayan kişiye yüklemek.

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.translation: Bu yer değiştirme, zararı çıkaran kişiyi zararı çeken kişinin yerine koydu.
การสลับบทนี้ทำให้ผู้ที่ก่อความเสียหายยืนอยู่ในตำแหน่งของผู้เสียหาย
Pertukaran itu menempatkan orang yang menyebabkan kerugian pada tempat orang yang mengalaminya.
A inversão colocou a pessoa que causou o dano no lugar de quem sofreu a ofensa.
그 가해자·피해자 뒤바꾸기 때문에 피해를 입은 사람이 가해자의 자리를 차지했다.
その逆転によって、被害を受けた人物に加害の責任が帰された。

d6b161b4ee4a0893129b91bb2d4602a8033b757e.text: The reversal put the person who caused the harm in the place of the person who suffered it.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: A place in a text where two meanings are held at once and the reader must choose one.
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.gloss: A place in a text where two meanings are held at once and the reader must choose one.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: 글에서 둘 이상의 의미가 동시에 성립하여 독자가 해석을 선택해야 하는 지점이다. 때로는 의도된 장치이지만, 보통은 뜻이 불분명함을 가리킨다.
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.gloss: 한 문장에 두 의미가 동시에 가능해 독자가 하나를 선택해야 하는 부분이다.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: Situação em que uma palavra, frase ou construção admite mais de uma interpretação, deixando o leitor diante de escolhas. Pode ser intencional ou passar despercebida.
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.gloss: Trecho de um texto em que dois sentidos coexistem, cabendo ao leitor escolher um.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: Tempat dalam teks yang memuat dua makna sekaligus sehingga pembaca harus memilih salah satunya. Ambiguitas dapat muncul karena kata, sintaksis, atau latar yang tidak jelas.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: Bir ifadenin ya da metin bölümünün birden fazla olası anlama gelebildiği durum. Okur, bağlamdan yararlanarak hangi anlamın amaçlandığını belirlemelidir.
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.gloss: Bir metinde aynı anda birden fazla anlam bulunan ve okurun birini seçmesi gereken yer.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.definition: 文章の一部に複数の意味が同時に存在し、書き手や読み手がどちらを意図したか判断しなければならない状態。曖昧さ。
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.gloss: 一箇所に複数の意味が同居し、読者bonusが解釈を選ぶ必要がある箇所。

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.translation: 最終行の曖昧さは意図的なもので、読者が解釈をひとつに決めなければならない。

A ambiguidade da última linha é deliberada, e o leitor precisa resolvê-la.

d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.text: The ambiguity in the last line is deliberate, and the reader has to settle it.
d6e6515990161d155625c597f46bdd8e69602944.translation: Sự mơ hồ trong dòng cuối cùng là cố ý, và người đọc phải tự quyết định.
